title: Sleeper-Z Dragon Ball Z Structured Question Bank
adaptationBoundary: Released Dragon Ball Z television anime continuity only (episodes 1-291); excludes Dragon Ball Kai-only editing differences, Dragon Ball Super, GT, films unless directly part of Z TV continuity, manga-only facts, games, and fan claims.

units.title: Frieza, Trunks, Androids, and Cell Foundations

notes: Original wording; exactly 5 units and 15 unique questions per unit.
Episode ranges and the 291-episode TV boundary were cross-checked against Toei Animation, Kanzenshuu, and Crunchyroll episode guides.

The source status is verified for all retained questions; no unresolved episode references were retained.
